name: prompt-optimizer
description: Compare models or optimize prompts from customer text logs, locally or in AgentCore, with quality, cost and latency evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Compare models or optimize text-task prompts
interface.longDescription: Use progressive intake with your text logs, compare models or optimize prompts, then inspect quality, cost per attempt, cost per successful result, latency and individual evidence locally or on AgentCore.
defaultPrompt: Show me the interactive results dashboard and explain what the saved evidence can support.
Help me prepare the support-ticket triage starter and challenge its expected answers.
Prepare a model comparison and help me choose local or AgentCore execution.
Help optimize my application prompt using my LiteLLM logs, with separate development, validation and held-out results.
